authority.effective_when: The applicable ADR and this manifest are merged to main

repositories.notes: Thin ecosystem coordination, topology, compatibility, release composition and cross-repository governance authority; no product runtime source.

History continuity from blakinio/Oteryn-v2 is proven, but migration acceptance remains blocked until ordinary source-side product work is frozen/retired and source-only work, copied refs, stale mutable coordinates and terminal source disposition are reconciled.

Stable repository identity is transferred to Oteryn. Migration acceptance still requires completion or explicit disposition of runner, package/GHCR, deployment/environment, App/webhook/deploy-key and external owner/repo-sensitive identity validation, stale-coordinate cleanup, migration-only machinery retirement and temporary-backup terminal disposition.

Target repository is authoritative for Atlas product work, but selective extraction remains incomplete until source-boundary provenance mapping, source-only work/branch disposition, protected-main/stable-gate proof and publication/provenance/rights decisions are closed.

administrative_repositories.purpose: Preserve the previous target-coordinate bootstrap state during the Platform owner-transfer transaction.
administrative_repositories.terminal_gate: Retain only until rollback/restore obligations and required migration evidence are resolved, then explicitly archive or delete under a separately authorized task.

migration_completion_rule: Repository presence or owner transfer is insufficient. MIGRATION_COMPLETE=YES requires mode-appropriate continuity, sole authority, source-work and stale-coordinate disposition, proven target merge enforcement, applicable non-Git identity/control-plane reconciliation, explicit source/transfer retirement, temporary-infrastructure disposition and preserved rollback/provenance. Proven blockers yield NO; missing required proof yields UNKNOWN.
contract_rule: Provider-owned schemas and runtime implementation remain canonical in provider repositories; META records coordinates, immutable identities and compatible combinations without normative duplication.
